This season I will plant maize on my plot as I always do. Here in Kigoma the rains come once a year and fertilizer is expensive and hard to find in the village — I have never used it, and I will not buy it this year either. I keep a few goats and chickens so I spread what little manure I have, and I save seed from last year's harvest like most of my neighbors. My wife and older children help me with the hoe work, but for clearing and the first weeding I will pay a few young men from the village to help, because 1.17 hectares is too much for us alone.
